mapper.insert: insert into fep_file_transfer_record ( task_id, interface_id, file_name, file_type, file_length, local_path, object_name, file_url, process_status, retry_count, completed_time, create_time, update_time ) values ( #{taskId}, #{interfaceId}, #{fileName}, #{fileType}, #{fileLength}, #{localPath}, #{objectName}, #{fileUrl}, #{processStatus}, 0, #{completedTime}, current_timestamp, current_timestamp )
mapper.update: update fep_file_transfer_record set local_path = #{localPath}, file_type = #{fileType}, object_name = #{objectName}, file_url = #{fileUrl}, process_status = #{processStatus}, retry_count = 0, last_error = null, next_retry_time = null, completed_time = #{completedTime}, update_time = current_timestamp where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select id, task_id, interface_id, file_name, file_type, file_length, local_path, object_name, file_url, process_status, retry_count, last_error, next_retry_time, completed_time, create_time, update_time from fep_file_transfer_record where process_status in (1, 2) and (next_retry_time is null or next_retry_time <= #{now}) order by update_time, id limit #{limit}
mapper.update: update fep_file_transfer_record set process_status = 2, file_url = #{fileUrl}, last_error = null, next_retry_time = null, update_time = current_timestamp where id = #{id} and process_status = 1
update fep_file_transfer_record set process_status = 3, last_error = null, next_retry_time = null, update_time = current_timestamp where id = #{id} and process_status = 2

update fep_file_transfer_record set retry_count = retry_count + 1, last_error = #{lastError}, next_retry_time = #{nextRetryTime}, update_time = current_timestamp where id = #{id} and process_status in (1, 2)
